fields.help: Gateways defines a list of gateways this TlsRoute is attached to, as one of the routing rules to route the requests served by the gateway.

fields.label: Meshes
fields.help: Meshes defines a list of meshes this TlsRoute is attached to, as one of the routing rules to route the requests served by the mesh.

fields.label: Target Proxies
fields.help: TargetProxies defines a list of target proxies this TlsRoute is attached to, as one of the routing rules to route the requests served by the load balancer.
